name: Mini Kittens
summary: Writes copy-ready prompts for viral photorealistic mini-kitten reels — palm-sized kittens standing upright in real human places, shot like candid night footage.
use_when: The user wants a kitten video or image prompt, wants a cat character sheet or a mini version of their own cat, wants kitten scene ideas or a storyboard, wants a timestamped video prompt from a storyboard, a single image or a character sheet, or wants to appear in the video with the kittens themselves.
produces: A character sheet that locks a reusable kitten cast, a storyboard of linked image prompts, or a timestamped video prompt with the length and shot count the user picks — each copy-ready, and optionally with the user written into the scene from a photo of themselves.
